principle: Describe stable module boundaries first; do not mass-move proven Godot and Android paths until path-sensitive builds have migration receipts.
mutationRules: A change begins with an exact base SHA and one claimed module scope.
Unknown or cross-module paths force broader validation rather than optimistic reuse.
A module may be reused only when its declared fingerprint and output receipts match.
Final APK export, package audit, alignment audit, permission audit, signing audit, and provenance receipt are never inherited from an older source SHA.
Source moves are migrations, not cleanup; each move must preserve runtime paths or include explicit compatibility changes and tests.
Generated build output and receipts stay outside canonical source folders and are never treated as source truth by themselves.

futurePhysicalLayout.note: Migration target only; not authorized as a bulk move.
